name: Serchen

sources.title: Serchen - Get Listed page (returned 403 to automated fetch)
Serchen homepage - business software marketplace (8,600+ apps, 138 categories, ~1M reviews)
Launch Point Zero - Serchen profile ('submitting is labor intensive and you'll get spammed for paid upgrades'; pay-to-submit: false)
ideaproof - Serchen submission profile (free, dofollow per their data)

requirements: Free company listing for business software vendors via https://www.serchen.com/get-listed/
Multi-step submission described by an independent submitter as 'labor intensive' - expect more than a single form
Company verification step exists; after verification Serchen offers a paid upgrade plan
preparation: Standard submission kit: product name, live URL, ~60-char tagline, ~250-char short description, square logo 512px+, 2-3 screenshots, pricing model, category
Company details for verification (website, contact info)
An email address you monitor - verification and upsell contact come by email
workflow: Open https://www.serchen.com/get-listed/ in a real browser (blocked automated fetches)
Complete the multi-step listing application with company and product details
Complete whatever verification Serchen requests (independent report: the company 'will offer you paid plan when you are verified')
Decline the paid upgrade if only the free listing is wanted; the free listing still creates a public company page (e.g. serchen.com/company/<slug>/)
watchFor: Expect persistent paid-upgrade solicitation after verification - third-party experience report calls it 'spamming you afterwards to pay to upgrade'
The 403 on automated fetch means the flow is browser-only; plan a manual session
Independent reviewer noted 'no actual improvement in web traffic' - treat the dofollow link/profile as the value, not referral traffic
The same site operates lead-gen contact forms for advertising - don't fill the wrong form
countsAsLive: A public company page exists at serchen.com/company/<slug>/ visible without login
unknowns: Exact fields/steps of the get-listed flow (page did not render publicly)
Current prices of the paid upgrade plans
